title: Adiong on questions to VP Sara's tree planting 'link' with Cale88: Don't be onion-skinned
summary: House prosecution spokesperson Zia Adiong on Saturday clapped back at the Office of the Vice President"s criticism against the impeachment prosecutors" questioning of Vice President Sara Duterte"s…

blocks.text: House prosecution spokesperson Zia Adiong on Saturday clapped back at the Office of the Vice President’s (OVP) criticism of the impeachment prosecutors’ questions to Vice President Sara Duterte’s tree planting activities and if it was related to Cale88 Food Corporation.

At a news forum, Adiong was asked for his reaction on the OVP’s statement that attempts to link Duterte’s participation in Cale88’s Board of Investments (BOI) compliance is “misleading, malicious, and has no factual basis.”

The House prosecution spokesperson said that raising questions on the Vice President’s tree planting activity was meant to “ascertain that this photo has nothing to do with the requirement of BOI for Cale88.”
During the cross examination of Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo on Day 45 of the trial, private prosecutor Erwin Matib flashed photos of Duterte planting trees.
“That how the cross examinations in regular trials are… That’s really part of the trial, it happens… So, ‘wag tayong maging onion-skinned dito,” Adiong said.

The OVP, in its statement, said it categorically denies any association between its "Pagbabago: A Million Trees Campaign" and Cale88 Foods Corporation's compliance with the BOI’s tree-planting requirement.
The OVP further said that its tree planting campaign is an "independent environmental initiative."

"The "Pagbabago: A Million Trees Campaign" is an independent environmental initiative of the OVP, launched on March 27, 2023, in support of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources' (DENR) efforts to reduce carbon emissions and address climate change," it said.

"The program is part of the OVP's advocacy to protect the environment for future generations. To date, the campaign, in partnership with various government agencies and private sectors, has planted 1,386,682 trees nationwide," added the OVP.

Cale88, the food firm linked to Duterte's husband Manases Carpio, has come under scrutiny during the impeachment trial over its profits earned with only two employees and its supposed financial inflows from China. —VAL, GMA News
